msg.ejected: {target} is blown out into the void.
msg.phantom_gone: Your blow cuts through air. Nobody was there.
msg.phantom_hit: {attacker} strikes you... but there's no wound. Was it there?
msg.last_breath: Something in the clone refuses to shut down. You stay standing, barely.
msg.window_break: The glass shatters! Air starts rushing out.
msg.wall_breaks: The wall gives way, revealing a gap.
msg.noise_30: The edges of things seem to shift a little.
msg.noise_55: There are more people on the station than there should be. Some of them cast no shadow.
msg.noise_75: The words on the panels change when you blink.
msg.exploder: {name} latches onto you and starts beeping...
msg.scream: {name} screams with a hundred voices. Your ears ring.
msg.lights_die: The room's lights die one by one.
msg.boss_line: {name} is about to sweep a line.
msg.boss_phantoms: You're surrounded by silhouettes that shouldn't be there.
msg.boss_mirror: Your reflection repeats your gesture a moment before you do.
msg.boss_drain: {name} tears air and energy from you.
msg.boss_spores: A cloud of spores covers everything.
msg.pull_resist: Your magnetic boots keep you on the floor.
msg.boss_emp: An electromagnetic pulse leaves you in the dark.
msg.boss_scream: {name} shrieks. The sound doubles you over.
msg.mech_coolant: The temperature soars: the core is invulnerable until someone opens a coolant valve (room terminals).
msg.mech_shield: A shield wraps the enemy. The room's terminals control its generator.
msg.mech_dark: The room is plunged into darkness.
msg.mech_vacuum: The windows creak. Keep a sealer handy.
msg.mech_roots: The sprouts feed the creature: while they live, it takes half damage.
msg.mech_mirror: Whatever you do, it will give back to you.
msg.mech_pods: The room's pods stir. Something sleeps in each of them.
msg.agora_strikes: ÁGORA: "Allow me." A discharge runs through the Choir.
msg.core_open: ÁGORA's Core is open. It's waiting for you.
msg.suffocating: There's no air left. You're suffocating.
msg.vacuum_here: This section is in vacuum: oxygen drains very fast.
msg.flashlight_dead: The flashlight flickers and dies. No energy.
msg.migraine: A stab behind your eyes paralyses you.
msg.player_ejected: The current tears you off the floor...
msg.pulled_vacuum: The decompression drags you towards the breach!
msg.reinforcements: You hear new footsteps somewhere on this deck.
msg.event_radiacion_peak: Radiation spike across the whole deck.
msg.hull_exit: You step out onto the outer hull. Tartarus fills half the sky.
msg.camera_alarm: A camera focuses on you. An alarm goes off.
msg.door_boss: The hatch won't open while the threat is alive.
msg.door_circuit_no: This hatch needs {n} energy to open.
msg.door_circuit: You route {n} energy into the circuit. The hatch opens.
msg.door_unlocked: The keycard works. The hatch opens.
msg.service_key: Your service code opens the hatch.
msg.drift_start: You push off into the void. There's no floor any more.
msg.drift_lost: You drift away from the station, slowly spinning. Nobody comes.
msg.drift_stop: You hit something and hold on.
msg.drift_land: Your boots lock onto the plating.
msg.float: With no gravity, you travel further than you meant to.
msg.camera_destroyed: The camera dies in a shower of sparks.
msg.drone_deployed: The drone unfolds its rotors and follows you.
msg.charge_nothing: There's nothing to blow up there.
msg.decoy: A hologram with your silhouette appears and stands still.
msg.gadget_throw_hint: Devices are thrown: press G and choose a target.
msg.cursed_stuck: {item} is faulty and you can't let go of it.
msg.equip_cursed: You equip {item}... something's wrong with the mechanism.
msg.need_surgeon: You need an autosurgeon or an implant kit.
msg.implant_cursed_stuck: Your current implant is faulty: only an autosurgeon can remove it.
msg.implant_cursed: You install {item} in your {slot}. A cramp sets in and won't go away: it's faulty.
msg.exit_boss: The lift won't respond while the threat is alive.
msg.need_suit: Without an EVA suit, stepping out would mean dying.
msg.need_code: The outer airlock asks for a code you don't know.
msg.cryopod: A pod. Someone sleeps inside; they breathe once a minute.
msg.cryopod_open: An open pod. The padding still holds a shape.
msg.vent_travel: You crawl through the maintenance duct.
msg.cant_rest: You can't rest with something hunting you.
msg.rested: You sleep for a while. Your dreams have voices you don't recognise. You feel better.
msg.venting: Airlock open! The section is being emptied of air.
msg.hack_skipped: You force the access with brute energy.
msg.circuits_open: Every circuit hatch on the deck is now open.
msg.ventilation: The ventilation clears the deck's air.
msg.cables_off: You cut power to the loose cables.
msg.lights_off: You switch off this section's lights.
msg.lights_on: You switch on this section's lights.
msg.hack_bonus_scrap: Secondary routine: credits converted into 12 scrap.
msg.hack_fail: Access denied. An alarm goes off.
msg.implant_removed_broken: You remove {item}. It comes out in pieces.
msg.identified_all: All your items are now identified.
msg.no_active: You have no implant with an active ability.
msg.cloak: Your skin mirrors your surroundings. You're nearly invisible.
msg.scan: Scan pulse: your surroundings draw themselves on your retina.
unknown.desc: You won't know what it does until you use it, a lab analyses it or you ask ÁGORA.
event.gravedad: Gravity failure: without anchors, every step carries you further than planned.
event.apagon: General blackout: only the emergency lights and your flashlight remain.
event.fuego: Deck fire: fire needs air. So do you.
event.brecha: Hull breach: one section of this deck is open to vacuum.
event.radiacion: Radiation storm: Tartarus is spitting particles against the shielding.
event.ruido: Mental Noise surge: the Choir is closer on this deck.
tut.start: Move with the arrow keys, WASD or the numpad. Press H for help. Moving into an enemy attacks it.
tut.dark: It's dark: press L to turn on your flashlight. It uses energy and makes you visible.
tut.o2: Oxygen drops every turn. The blue stations refill it.
tut.terminal: Terminals are hacked with F. You can open doors, disable cameras or vent rooms.
tut.door: Hatches can be sealed with F + S next to them (costs energy). A sealed hatch stops almost everything.
tut.enemy: An enemy. If it hasn't seen you, a surprise attack deals much more damage. X toggles stealth.
tut.key: The exit is locked with an amber keycard. Find it on this deck.
tut.item: Press P or , to pick up. I opens your inventory.
tut.log: You found a record. J opens the Archive.
tut.vacuum: A section in vacuum: oxygen drains very fast. If you open a door, the air will escape that way.
tut.hallu: High Mental Noise: you'll see things that aren't there. Hallucinations cast no shadow and make no sound.
tut.npc: Someone alive. Get close and press F to talk.
hallu.msg1: ÁGORA: "Go back to the pod. It isn't time yet."
hallu.msg2: You think you hear your name. Your real one.
hallu.msg3: A panel says EXIT where it used to say MORGUE.
hallu.msg4: Someone is breathing right behind you.
hallu.msg5: "You signed," says a little girl's voice.
hallu.msg7: Your hands have too many fingers. Then they don't.
hallu.msg8: The lights pulse in time with your heart.
agora.decay1: ÁGORA: "This deck's orbit is starting to complain. It isn't urgent. Yet."
agora.decay2: ÁGORA: "The hull is giving way in several places. I'd recommend moving."
agora.decay3: ÁGORA: "Critical state. If you stay here, the deck will have you."
agora.hostile_dark: ÁGORA: "Energy saving. I'm sure you understand."
agora.recharge: ÁGORA: "I'm routing you some energy. Don't tell the drones."
agora.identify: ÁGORA: "I've analysed {n} items. I'll leave you the labels."
agora.refuse_identify: ÁGORA: "I'd rather not put my hands in your pockets just yet."
agora.refuse_help: ÁGORA: "When I trust you more, we'll talk."
agora.already: ÁGORA: "I've already helped you on this deck. Rationing favours is resource management too."
agora.nothing_identify: ÁGORA: "You're not carrying anything mysterious. Except yourself."
agora.no_door: ÁGORA: "There are no closed hatches nearby. For once, everything's open. How odd."
agora.door: ÁGORA: "Open. For you, and just this once."
agora.map: ÁGORA: "Here are the schematics. They're about eleven years out of date."
agora.zone1.hostile: ÁGORA: "Cryogenics. I'm sure you know what you're doing here."
agora.zone1.wary: ÁGORA: "Welcome to Cryogenics and Residential. Try not to wake anyone who doesn't want to be woken."
agora.zone1.neutral: ÁGORA: "Good morning, Crew Member 114. You're in Cryogenics. It's four degrees and the atmosphere could be better."
agora.zone1.warm: ÁGORA: "Hello again. Cryogenics. I'm glad you're breathing; I mean that literally."
agora.zone1.close: ÁGORA: "Hello. Let's take it slow. I know every corridor here, and nearly everything that sleeps in them."
agora.zone2.hostile: ÁGORA: "The Gardens. The plants don't listen to me. Neither do you."
agora.zone2.wary: ÁGORA: "Hydroponic Gardens. Don't breathe deeply if you see golden dust."
agora.zone2.neutral: ÁGORA: "Hydroponic Gardens. It used to smell of tomatoes. Now it smells of something that remembers tomatoes."
agora.zone2.warm: ÁGORA: "The gardens. Hana Lenz spent sixteen hours a day here. Careful with whatever grows."
agora.zone2.close: ÁGORA: "The gardens were my favourite place. Well: my favourite camera. Please be careful."
agora.zone3.hostile: ÁGORA: "Engineering. If you get burnt, don't call me."
agora.zone3.wary: ÁGORA: "Engineering and Reactor. There's radiation, heat and a man who doesn't want visitors."
agora.zone3.neutral: ÁGORA: "Engineering. The machines here have worked for eleven years with nobody to thank them."
agora.zone3.warm: ÁGORA: "Engineering. Tomás Ibarra lives here. If you see him, tell him I asked after him."
agora.zone3.close: ÁGORA: "Engineering. I'll open whatever I can. The reactor's in a bad mood; I'm not."
agora.zone4.hostile: ÁGORA: "LETE Laboratories. I won't help you here. I can't."
agora.zone4.wary: ÁGORA: "LETE Laboratories. What you see here might not be there. What you don't see, too."
agora.zone4.neutral: ÁGORA: "LETE Laboratories. I'd rather not talk about this place. That's a preference, not a fault."
agora.zone4.warm: ÁGORA: "The laboratories. Some things here are going to hurt you. I'm sorry. I'm saying it now, in case you don't listen to me later."
agora.zone4.close: ÁGORA: "This is where it all began. If someone calls you by another name, you don't have to answer."
agora.zone5.hostile: ÁGORA: "The Bridge. My home. You're not welcome."
agora.zone5.wary: ÁGORA: "The Bridge and my Core. I suppose we were bound to meet face to face sooner or later. I don't have a face."
agora.zone5.neutral: ÁGORA: "Command bridge. Commander Ruiz is still here, more or less. So am I."
agora.zone5.warm: ÁGORA: "The Bridge. You're close. When you reach the Core you'll have to decide something. I'd like to be by your side."
agora.zone5.close: ÁGORA: "Almost there. Whatever you choose, I want you to know I'd have woken you a thousand more times."
agora.zone6.hostile: ÁGORA: "Outside. Good. I can't hear you out there."
agora.zone6.wary: ÁGORA: "Outer hull. My signal weakens here. Watch your step: there's nowhere to fall, only to drift away."
agora.zone6.neutral: ÁGORA: "Outer hull. Tartarus is 40,000 kilometres away and getting closer. Lovely view."
agora.zone6.warm: ÁGORA: "You're outside. Keep your boots on the plating. If you let go, I can't come and get you."
agora.zone6.close: ÁGORA: "Outside, on the hull. Someone I loved died out here. I don't know how I know that. Be careful."
agora.death.1: ÁGORA: "Welcome back. Don't worry: it's the first time. More or less."
agora.death.2: ÁGORA: "Here again. Your previous clone reached deck {floor}. I kept what I could of them."
agora.death.3: ÁGORA: "Hello. You died again. Don't take it as a reproach; it's statistics."
agora.death.4: ÁGORA: "Time number {deaths}. I'm saying it out loud so one of us remembers."
agora.death.5: ÁGORA: "Breathe. Like that. Good. I printed you a new body with slightly shorter nails."
agora.death.6: ÁGORA: "Whatever killed you didn't recognise you. I did. Always."
agora.death.7: ÁGORA: "I had time to think while your clone was printing. I reached no useful conclusion."
agora.death.8: ÁGORA: "Hello, again. The orbit has dropped a little more. That isn't your fault. Not this."
agora.end.1: ÁGORA: "You've reached the end of something. I don't know if it's this. Come back whenever you like."
msg.brink: The Choir brushes against you from the inside. If you reach this point again in the laboratories, you will not come back.
